name: Spring Switch
description: Switches with weight: the thumb stretches as it travels and lands on a spring, async switches hold a spinner, and a refused change shakes back.
usage:
import { SwitchSpring } from "@/components/design-for-ai/switch-spring";

<SwitchSpring
  label="Push to this phone"
  description="Registers this device for alerts."
  defaultChecked
  async
  onCheckedChange={(next) => api.settings.update({ push: next })} // return the promise to hold the thumb
/>

<SwitchSpring label="Product updates" size="sm" icons labelSide="right" accent="#7dd3a8" />

props.name: label
props.description: The switch's name, read by screen readers and set beside the track.

props.name: description
props.description: One quiet line under the label, in the muted ink.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled state. The switch only moves when this changes, so update it from onCheckedChange once the change has landed.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Runs when the person flips the switch. Return a promise to wait on the change; if it rejects, the switch stays where it was.

props.name: async
props.description: Holds the thumb in a spinner until the promise from onCheckedChange settles, then lands it; a handler that returns nothing lands at once. Off, the thumb moves at once and a rejection rolls it back. Either way a rejection shakes the thumb, shows the message in red in place of the description, and announces it.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The line shown in red, and announced politely, when a change is refused, in place of the description for about 3.5 s. Defaults to "Couldn't turn on <label>. Try again." (or off).

props.name: pendingHint
props.default: "Confirms with the server before it switches."
props.description: The visually hidden line an async switch adds to aria-describedby, so screen readers know the change waits. Pass a translated string.

props.name: size
props.description: Track of 32, 40 or 52 px wide. The label scales with it.

props.name: icons
props.description: Glyphs in the track: a check on the side the thumb has left when on, a cross when off.

props.name: labelSide
props.description: Which side of the track the label sits on. Left reads like a settings list, with the track centred on the row; right suits forms, with the track centred on the label's first line.

props.name: accent
props.description: The fill while on, and the colour the thumb and glyphs take against it: the thumb turns near-black on a light accent and white on a darker one. Leave out for the theme's ink. The first swatch in the playground is the theme's ink.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the switch sits on, so its track, thumb and muted text keep their contrast.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch and dims the row to 40%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, for spacing inside a list.
